title: Frontier AI Labs Schema
description: Organisations that develop frontier AI systems, with founding dates carried alongside the evidence for them. Facts only: this collection asserts no game impacts, no rarity and no salience. Inclusion is itself an editorial judgement and is therefore recorded per row in inclusion_basis rather than left implicit.

id.description: Stable slug. Never reused, never renamed; a rename creates a new id and sets the old row's status to renamed.

name.description: Display name, ASCII only. Source dumps in this repo carry encoding damage (for example 'UniversitA de MontrAal'), so names here are re-typed rather than copied.

aliases.description: Other names the same organisation appears under, including names used in the Epoch AI dump.

founded.description: ISO 8601 date at the precision the evidence supports: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. NULL WHERE NO CITED DATE WAS FOUND. Null is ungated and honest; a fabricated date is indistinguishable from a real one later. Do not fill this from memory or by inference from a relative phrase such as 'founded two years ago'.

founded_precision.description: Precision actually supported by founded_evidence. Must be null exactly when founded is null.

founded_evidence.description: What was read, and the sentence that carried the date. Present even where founded is null, to record what was checked.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence from that page containing the date

publisher.description: Who publishes the page, and any record identifier such as a company number

founded_contested.description: True where credible sources disagree, or where founded / incorporated / announced / emerged-from-stealth are meaningfully different events.

founded_alternatives.description: Other defensible dates, each labelled with what it represents. A consumer wanting 'when did this lab become publicly visible' should read this rather than founded.

what_it_represents.description: For example: statutory incorporation, public announcement, emergence from stealth, internal project start

evidence_strength.description: How much weight founded can bear. Graded on source class, not on confidence. 'registry' = a statutory company register. 'first_party' = the organisation's own site. 'press' = journalism that states the date. 'secondary' = encyclopedia or trade-press boilerplate, or a citation chain that does not resolve. 'none' = no citable date found; founded must be null.

status.description: Current disposition. Note that a reverse-acquihire, where staff and a licence move but no equity changes hands, is NOT 'acquired'; such organisations stay 'active' with the event recorded in notes.

parent_org.description: id of the parent row where the parent is also in this collection, otherwise a plain name. Set only where an equity relationship is evidenced.

country.description: Country of headquarters at founding. Null where genuinely unclear rather than guessed; some organisations are dual-sited from the start.

lab_kind.description: What kind of thing this row is. Provided so that a consumer counting 'how many frontier labs exist' picks its own filter instead of inheriting ours. A count of dedicated_ai_lab is a very different number from a count of every row.

inclusion_basis.description: Why this row is in the collection. 'epoch_frontier_model' is mechanical: credited on at least one model flagged Frontier model in the Epoch AI notable-models database with a publication date in range. 'editorial' is a judgement call, and inclusion_reason must then say why the mechanical rule missed it.

inclusion_reason.description: Required where inclusion_basis is editorial. States what the mechanical rule missed and why the row belongs anyway.

epoch_frontier_models.description: Count of Epoch-flagged frontier models this organisation is credited on, in range. Null where the organisation does not appear in the Epoch dump at all, which is different from zero.

epoch_first_frontier_model.description: Publication date of the earliest Epoch-flagged frontier model credited to this organisation. A weak lower bound on when the organisation was doing frontier work, and NOT a founding date.

sources.description: Every URL consulted for this row, including ones that did not yield a date.

notes.description: What a careful reader should know. Decoy corporate records that were rejected belong here, so the next person does not re-find them and adopt them.

extra.description: Escape hatch for fields not yet standardised. Anything here is unversioned and may move into a named field in a later schema version. Reserved for: funding_total, headcount_band, notable_models, safety_team_presence, jurisdiction.

allOf.description: founded and founded_precision agree about being absent.
A null founded must be justified by evidence_strength none.
An editorial inclusion must say why the mechanical rule missed it.
